text: 1、市场早间高开震荡，三大指数小幅反弹。创新药概念集体爆发，三元基因、石药创新、莱美药业、昂利康等多股涨停。黄金概念股拉升，深中华A、南矿集团涨停。算力硬件股反弹，通鼎互联、宝鼎科技、中京电子等涨停。下跌方面，农业股下挫，华绿生物跌超10%。个股涨多跌少，沪深京三市超4300股飘红，上午半天成交1.38万亿。午间收盘沪指涨0.28%，深成指涨0.97%，创业板涨1.03%。 2、板块概念方面，创新药、黄金、CPO、PCB等板块领涨；农业、煤炭、油气、保险等板块领跌； 3、两市共4170只个股上涨，83只个股涨停；932只个股下跌，5只个股跌停；26只股票
text_en: 1. The market opened higher with fluctuations in the morning, and the three major indices rebounded slightly. Innovative drug concepts collectively surged, with Sanyuan Gene, CSPC Innovation, Lummy and Anglikang among stocks hitting the daily limit. Gold concept stocks rallied, with Shenzhen Zhongheng Huafa and Nan Kuang Group hitting the daily limit. Computing hardware stocks rebounded, with Tongding Interconnection, Baoding Technology and Shenzhen Jingzhong Electronics hitting the daily limit. On the downside, agricultural stocks fell, with Hualu Bio down over 10%. More stocks rose than fell, with over 4,300 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets in the red, and morning turnover at RMB 1.38 trillion. At midday close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.28%, Shenzhen Component rose 0.97%, and ChiNext rose 1.03%. 2. By sector and concept, innovative drugs, gold, CPO and PCB led gains; agriculture, coal, oil and gas and insurance led losses. 3.
